note: Signature-derived by hand from agent/*.py (Agno infers the same JSON schema from the Python signature); descriptions are the docstrings' first sentence. The DB `description` column may override them in production (utils/tool_loader.py). Only the tools the coursebuilder world uses are listed; an automated dump was attempted but the subagent was cut off by API overload twice.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image and return its public URL. prompt: description of the image to generate, no style words unless the user named a style; style: the style the user named, or auto; context: one line on the course/lesson subject.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate (e.g., an avocado on a wooden cutting board). No style words unless the user named a style.

style.description: The style the user named, or auto to infer one from the subject and context.

context.description: One line on the course/lesson subject and the style of the existing images.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an existing image and return the new image's public URL.

image_url.description: URL of the existing image to edit (e.g. the current image of the selected element).

prompt.description: Description of the change to make (e.g., make it cartoon style, replace the man with a woman).

reference_image_urls.description: Optional additional image URLs to guide the edit.

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Export markdown, HTML, or CSV content as a downloadable file (pdf, docx, txt, md, html, csv).

title.description: Document title (rendered as the top heading).

content_markdown.description: The document body, in the language the format names (markdown for pdf/docx/txt/md).

tools.name: contact_us
tools.description: Send a message to the team. Use when users want to provide feedback, ask a question, report a bug, or request a callback. Requires a message and at least one way to contact them (email or phone).

tools.name: course_search_and_create
tools.description: Search for existing courses, create new ones if no matches found. Always searches the course library first; if no matches for any topic, creates new course outlines.

topics.description: Topics to search for or create courses about (max 10).

tools.name: start_free_trial
tools.description: Invoke this tool when the user approves course outline(s) and wants to proceed to signup.

tools.name: knowledge_base_search
tools.description: Query the knowledge base. Real tool names are sanitize_name(kb.name) per knowledge base (LEARNER_HOW_TO, PLATFORM_FEATURES, user-named notebooks); each has this one parameter.

query.description: The question to search the knowledge base with.
